name: DEF CON
description: One of the world's largest and most notable hacker conventions, held annually in Las Vegas. Features multiple tracks, villages, contests, and communities.

peerReview.processDescription: Community-driven selection with multiple content tracks. Calls for Papers for talks, workshops, Demo Labs, and policy. Village, contest, and community submissions reviewed by organizers. Selection based on technical merit, originality, and community interest.

attribution.attributionNotes: Speaker certificates. Black Badges for exceptional contributions. Community recognition. Media coverage.

povsAlignment.description: Community conference with community-driven selection and Black Badge recognition.
